name: Text #1 — Standard (business hours) ★ start with this one
text: Hi, this is {You} with {Business}. Sorry I missed your call, I'm on a job right now. What can I help you with? Reply here and I'll get back to you within the hour.

name: Text #2 — After hours
text: Hi, it's {You} at {Business}. We're closed for the night, but I saw your call. Reply with what you need and the best time to reach you, and I'll call first thing in the morning. If it's an emergency, reply URGENT.

name: Text #3 — Weekend
text: Thanks for calling {Business}! We're off for the weekend but checking messages. Tell me what's going on and I'll get you on the schedule. Monday mornings fill up fast, so I'll hold a spot if you reply today.

name: Text #4 — Emergency trades (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, restoration)
text: This is {Business}, sorry we missed you. If you have water leaking, no heat/AC, sparking or a gas smell, reply NOW and we'll call you right back. For gas smells, leave the house and call your gas company first. Otherwise reply with a quick description and we'll get you scheduled.

name: Text #5 — Booking-link version
text: Hi, {You} from {Business} here. Missed your call! Fastest way to get on the schedule is here: {Link}. Or just reply with what you need and I'll text you back.

name: Text #6 — Second touch (if no reply after 2–3 hours)
text: Just checking you got sorted, {First}. Still happy to help with that if you need it. I have an opening {tomorrow morning / Thursday afternoon}.

name: Text #7 — Final touch (next day, no reply)
text: No worries if you found someone, {First}! If you still need {Trade}, we're here. Just reply to this text. — {You}, {Business}

name: Voicemail greeting (record this — 20 seconds)
text: "You've reached {Business}, this is {You}. I'm probably on a job. You'll get a text from this number in the next few minutes. Just reply to it with what you need, it's the fastest way to reach me. If it's an emergency, say 'emergency' in your message and I'll call right back."

name: Touch 1 — Day 0/1 · Text · "Here's your quote"
text: Hi {First}, it's {You} from {Business}. Your quote for {Job} is in your email. Any questions at all, just reply here. Happy to walk you through it.

name: Touch 2 — Day 3 · Email · "The question most people ask"
text: Hi {First},  Following up on the {Job} quote I sent over on {date}.  The question I get most often is *"why does it cost this much?"* Here's the honest breakdown: {one or two sentences, e.g. "about half is the unit itself, the rest is the labor to install it to code and haul the old one away"}.  If anything in the quote is unclear, or you want to see a lower-cost option, just reply and I'll put one together.  Thanks, {You} {Business} · {Phone}

name: Touch 3 — Day 7 · Text · "Options"
text: Hi {First}, {You} again. If the {Job} quote is more than you planned, I can do a {smaller scope / phased / basic} version for around {lower price}. Want me to send that over?

name: Touch 4 — Day 14 · Email · "Schedule / timing"
text: Hi {First},  Quick one. Our schedule for {month} is starting to fill. If you'd like the {Job} done before {season/holiday/the hot weather}, I can hold {date option 1} or {date option 2} for you.  If the timing isn't right, no problem at all. Just let me know and I'll stop nudging.  {You}

name: Touch 5 — Day 21 · Text · "Closing the loop"
text: Hi {First}, I'll close out your {Job} quote this week so I'm not bugging you. If you went another way, totally fine. Would you mind telling me why? One word is plenty (price / timing / went with someone else). It helps me a lot. Thanks either way! — {You}

name: If they reply "too expensive"
text: Totally fair, thanks for being straight with me. Can I ask what you were hoping to spend? Sometimes I can change the scope, the materials or the timing to get closer. If not, no hard feelings.

name: If they reply "we went with someone else"
text: Thanks for letting me know, {First}. I appreciate it. If anything comes up down the road, I'm a text away. Good luck with the project!

name: Calling back a missed caller
text: "Hi, is this {First}? This is {You} from {Business}. You called us a little while ago and I'm sorry I missed you. I was on a job. What's going on?"

name: Quote follow-up call (Day 30 or big tickets)
text: "Hi {First}, it's {You} from {Business}. I'm calling about the {Job} quote. I'm not calling to pressure you, I just know quotes can be confusing. Was there anything in it you'd like me to explain?"  *(Listen. Don't fill silence.)*  If interested: "Great, the earliest I can get you in is {date}. Does that work?" If not now: "No problem. Would it help if I checked back in {a month / spring}?" If no: "Totally understand. Do you mind if I ask what made the decision? It helps me improve."
